push.body:
BellyTb1, a 6.4 against Project 2030. Tomorrow's a clean sheet of paper, and I've got a fresh pencil.

THE GOOD
+ Giveaways 0, down from your usual 6. That's growth you can count.
+ Top-rated Grizzly in the match. That's the bit I'll replay in my head on the drive home.
+ Missed tackles 0, down from your usual 1. I see you, and I like what I see.

THE BAD
- Only 0 passes (down from your usual 20). Low-hanging fruit: Give the passer an angle - diagonal to the ball, not flat in a line where it can't reach you. We'll drill it till it's dull.
- No tackles attempted (down from your usual 2). Quick fix: Know your runner before the cross comes in. A quick look over the shoulder saves a goal. It's coming.
- Shots 0, down from your usual 3. Quick one: Attack the box. Near post and far post on every cross and every cutback.
- You and tuxedo_slide can fix on-ball involvement as a duo: make triangles, 1-2 touch.
- We shipped 4 goals to Project 2030 and lost by 4. We dug that hole together; we'll climb out together.

THE UGLY
! Match rating 6.4, down from your usual 8.1. That one hurt the team, and the team deserves better.

Daily reps: Play with your head up between touches. You can't find a pass you never looked for.

BellyTb1, you already know this, but I'll say it anyway: A goal is just a pass to the net.

Today's lessons are tomorrow's strengths. - Coach Lasso

One rough patch doesn't define a field. - Coach Lasso
